tasks.goal: Move reading auto-checkin from client (page.tsx handleQuizComplete) to server (/api/reading/quiz/submit). Server inserts check_ins row in the same transaction as the quiz attempt, returns checkin status in response. Eliminates race window and silent client-side failures.
acceptance: createReadingAutoCheckin callable from /api/reading/quiz/submit using server supabase client
API response includes checkin_status: 'created' | 'deduped' | 'skipped' | 'failed' with server-side error reason on failed
createReadingAutoCheckin no longer silently swallows errors — returns { ok, error } instead of null
Vitest covers: (a) created on first attempt, (b) deduped on second attempt same day same article, (c) skipped when no matching homework, (d) failed surfaces the underlying error
verification: diff shows API returns checkin_status field
diff shows client-side handleQuizComplete no longer inserts into check_ins

tasks.goal: Add DB RLS policies to fix the silent-failure chain: (1) child can UPDATE own check_ins for the re-read dedup, (2) child can UPDATE own children row on reading_level_zh/_en/_zh_max/_en_max columns so auto-level bump actually applies. Both policies must be narrow (column-scoped where possible) to avoid widening attack surface.
acceptance: 060 adds: CREATE POLICY 'Child can update own check_ins' ON check_ins FOR UPDATE USING (child_id IN (SELECT id FROM children WHERE auth.uid() = id))

061 adds: CREATE POLICY 'Child can update own reading level' ON children FOR UPDATE USING (auth.uid() = id) WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = id) — note: column-scoped UPDATE is not natively supported in Postgres RLS, so this policy allows the child to update their own row but trust boundary requires that the API code only writes the level columns; add a server-side guard in /api/reading/quiz/submit that constructs the update object with only the level keys
Both migrations are idempotent (DO $$ ... EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object THEN NULL)
Migrations apply cleanly against a fresh DB AND against the existing migration chain
No new INSERT/DELETE policy on children (parent-only remains)
verification: psql or supabase db push dry-run shows no errors
npx vitest run (existing tests still pass)
Manual verify (deferred to QA): a child user can now successfully UPDATE check_ins.note and children.reading_level_zh
